retrievalProfile.description: A dual-subject outdoor portrait featuring warm, sun-drenched lighting and bold, top-aligned sans-serif typography in yellow and orange tones.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of two men in 1960s attire, one holding an acoustic guitar, set against a soft-focus background of sunlit trees. The composition is anchored by heavy, vibrant typography at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm yellow text contrasts against the dark green and brown foliage background.
The subjects are positioned centrally, with the guitar neck creating a vertical line on the left.
The lighting is directional, creating high-contrast highlights on the subjects' faces and clothing.
The typography is layered over the top of the photographic image without a border.
coreInvariants: Bold, heavy-weight sans-serif typeface for the primary title.
Warm, saturated color palette dominated by oranges, yellows, and earthy greens.
Soft-focus natural background with dappled sunlight.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects occupy the center and right-middle ground, scaled to a medium-close-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, orange-yellow title text at the top center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold title, moves down to the subjects' faces, and follows the guitar neck upward back to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area around the guitar neck provide breathing room amidst the dense foliage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy greens and browns in the background foliage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and orange used for the primary and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue of the denim jacket and crisp white of the dress shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against a medium-value, naturally lit photographic background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is a contrasting, lighter-weight serif or decorative style.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display sans-serif paired with a lighter, more standard bold sans-serif for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules in the bottom right corner for metadata.

preserve: Lowercase casing for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the primary title.
Appropriate for the secondary subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of two young men in 1960s fashion (one in a dark blazer, one in a denim jacket) standing in a sunlit forest. One man holds the neck of an acoustic guitar. Use a shallow depth of field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extra-heavy sans-serif text in lowercase at the top center in orange. Add a second line of bold yellow text directly beneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the color of the text vibrant yellow/orange?
Is the background foliage softly blurred?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck is visible on the left side.
Check that the text is legible against the foliage.
Verify the ampersand is a different style than the main letters.
Confirm the overall color temperature is warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1960s-style outdoor duo portrait with heavy, top-aligned sans-serif typography in a warm, high-contrast color palette.
